tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod la logs bris bgyis pa'i dkar chag dang ba 'dren byed bzhugs// bkra shis rgyal bar gyur cig 'dzam gling sa la dbang bsgyur 'phags pa yi/ /grub pa'i rtags mtshan rdzu 'phrul gyis sprul pa'i/ /gtsug lag khang chen rten dang brten par bcas/ /ngo mtshar rmad byung 'di yi khyams stod smad/ 1 /mdzes byed ra ba'i nang logs dbang po'i phyogs/ /de dang nor bdag phyogs dang chu bdag phyogs/ /kun tu sngon med bris sku'i snang brnyan ni/ /gsar du bskrun la bstan pa'i gtso bo dang / 2 /rgyal tshab byams pa sa skya'i gong ma lnga/ /sngags 'chang yab sras rje btsun mus chen te/ /de rnams sku yi bkod pa brgya phrag brgal/ /gzhan yang sgrol ma nyer gcig 'od dpag med/ 3 /mi 'khrugs pa sogs 'dod lha'i rigs mang po/ /khyad par sa skya'i yab chos gsung ngag gi /rtsa brgyud bla ma yi dam chos skyong tshogs/ /nor lhar bcas rnams 'dus pa rgya mtsho yi/ 4 /gral dbus mdzes byed gzi byin rab 'bar bas/ /su yis mthong yang dad pa'i spu long ni/ /dbang med g.yo bar nus pa 'di nyid dang / /gzhan yang gnas brtan bcu drug rgyal chen bzhi/ 5 /mgon po sku tshe dpag tu med pa'i sku/ /grangs dang tshad med lta bus phyogs kun tu/ /gang ba'i logs bris ngo mtshar can 'di rnams/ /bzo rig mkhas pa bon gong par grags pa'i/ 6 /rnam dpyod blo ldan shes rab 'byung gnas dang / /rig gnas 'di la sbyangs pa phul phyin pa'i/ /grags pa rin chen la sogs mched grogs lngas/ /dad dang brtson pas sor mo'i 'phrul las grub/ 7 /'di yi sbyin bdag sngags 'chang sa skya pa/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya ba'i/ /dam pa'i rigs su skyes kyang lung rtogs kyi/ /yon tan bral ba'i yar 'dren gzugs brnyan des/ 8 /dang 'dod yid ches dad pas kun bslangs te/ /bgyis pa 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob gdul byar bcas pa rnams/

/dus 'dir tshe ring nad med bsam don 'grub/ 9 /bstan pa cher rgyas don gnyis mthar phyin te/ /phyi ma dad ldan 'od zer mtha' can sogs/ /kun kyang dag pa'i zhing 'dzoms phan tshun rnams/ /ngo shes bsam sbyor mthun pas zhing de yi/ 10 /rgyal ba mnyes byas sa lam myur bsgrod de/ /gang 'dul sprul pas rje btsun sa skya pa'i/ /bstan pas gangs ljongs khyab pa'i mthu grub cing / /'gro kun dag pa'i zhing du 'dren gyur cig 11 /lhag bsam dag pa'i smon lam 'di 'grub phyir/ /bdag gzhan dus gsum sdig kun 'gyod pas bshags/ /dkon mchog thugs rjes sgrib kun byang gyur cig /phyin chad las nyon skye sgo chod par shog 12 /'khrul zad bla ma rnams kyi mkhyen brtse dang / /dkon mchog gsum gyi bden pa'i nus mthu dang / /bka' srung rnams kyi rmad byung 'phrin las kyis/ /don kun lhun gyis grub pa'i bkra shis byon/ / 13 ka lyā na wardhantu/ dge legs 'phel bar gyur cig sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 a myes zhabs/ lha khang chen mo'i khyams stod la shogs bris bgyis pa'i dkar chag dang ba 'dren byed/ PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 1
